verdict.rationale: RudderStack's Profiles feature lets marketers declare entities/attributes in YAML and automatically computes traits via feature aggregation and identity resolution (docs-19, docs-31, docs-35), and Audiences can be built on those warehouse profiles and activated to downstream tools (docs-27, docs-38). However, there is no evidence of built-in predictive modeling (LTV, churn, purchase propensity scores) — the docs only mention generic 'feature aggregation' and enrichment, not ML-based scoring outputs. Missing for 10: explicit predictive scoring models (LTV/churn/propensity) native to the product, and confirmation these scores can be directly used as targeting criteria in audience builders.
